prompt: Was the founder of the bank that was established 42 years before the National Banking Act was expanded to include the Territory of Hawai'i still alive when it acquired Pioneer Federal Savings Bank?
answer:
No. The bank was **Bishop & Co.**, founded in Honolulu in **1858** by **Charles Reed Bishop and William A. Aldrich**—42 years before the National Banking Act was extended to Hawaii in 1900.

First Hawaiian completed its acquisition of Pioneer Federal Savings Bank on **August 6, 1993**. Neither founder was alive then: **Charles Reed Bishop died in 1915**, and **William A. Aldrich died in 1908**.
